files.content:
[package]
name = "fcp-truthful-sample"
description = "V3-native FCP connector for truthful-sample"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
repository.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true

[[bin]]
name = "fcp-truthful-sample"
path = "src/main.rs"

[lints]
workspace = true

[dependencies]
fcp-sdk = { path = "../../crates/fcp-sdk" }

anyhow.workspace = true
chrono.workspace = true
futures-util.workspace = true
serde.workspace = true
serde_json.workspace = true
thiserror.workspace = true
fcp-async-core = { path = "../../crates/fcp-async-core" }
tracing.workspace = true
tracing-subscriber.workspace = true
uuid.workspace = true
sha2.workspace = true
hex.workspace = true

[dev-dependencies]
assert_cmd = "2.0"
fcp-crypto = { path = "../../crates/fcp-crypto" }
wiremock.workspace = true

# Flywheel Connector Manifest
# Generated by `fwc new` - review scaffold defaults before shipping

[manifest]
format = "fcp-connector-manifest"
schema_version = "2.1"
min_mesh_version = "2.0.0"
min_protocol = "fcp2-sym/2.0"
protocol_features = []
max_datagram_bytes = 1200
# Interface hash is auto-generated from declared operations.
interface_hash = "blake3-256:fcp.interface.v2:7a205abf301a954a920c5ba67ed4adeaeac53e13037d7aac852940b42631a898"

[connector]
id = "fcp.truthful-sample"
name = "Truthful-sample Connector"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Generated incubating scaffold for Truthful-sample; replace with a provider-specific description before shipping."
archetypes = ["operational"]
format = "native"
status = "incubating"

[connector.state]
model = "stateless"
state_schema_version = "1"

[zones]
# Single-zone binding (FCP2 requirement)
home = "z:project:truthful-sample"
allowed_sources = ["z:project:truthful-sample"]
allowed_targets = ["z:project:truthful-sample"]
forbidden = ["z:public"]

[capabilities]
# The scaffold_status operation requires its own capability; every
# operation's `capability` entry MUST appear in `required` or `optional`
# per manifest lint.  Add further required caps only after you have a
# matching invoke path and verification evidence.
required = ["truthful-sample.scaffold_status"]
optional = []
# Default-deny: explicitly forbid dangerous capabilities
forbidden = ["system.exec", "system.privileged"]

# The generated scaffold exposes one honest local-only operation that reports
# the connector's current non-live status and graduation checklist.
[provides.operations.scaffold_status]
description = "Report the scaffold's incubating status and the work required before live provider operations may be advertised."
capability = "truthful-sample.scaffold_status"
risk_level = "low"
safety_tier = "safe"
requires_approval = "none"
idempotency = "best_effort"
input_schema = { type = "object", properties = { include_next_steps = { type = "boolean" } } }
output_schema = { type = "object", properties = { connector_id = { type = "string" }, manifest_status = { type = "string" }, surface_status = { type = "string" }, live_requests_supported = { type = "boolean" }, implemented_operations = { type = "array", items = { type = "string" } }, next_steps = { type = "array", items = { type = "string" } } }, required = ["connector_id", "manifest_status", "surface_status", "live_requests_supported", "implemented_operations"] }

[provides.operations.scaffold_status.ai_hints]
when_to_use = "Use this to inspect the generated scaffold and confirm it still reports an incubating non-live surface."
common_mistakes = [
  "Treating this scaffold status response as proof of live upstream support",
  "Advertising new capabilities before the matching invoke path and verification evidence exist",
]

[timeouts]
request_timeout_ms = 30000
connect_timeout_ms = 5000
wall_clock_timeout_ms = 60000

[sandbox]
# Strict sandbox profile (FCP2 requirement)
profile = "strict"
memory_mb = 64
cpu_percent = 25
wall_clock_timeout_ms = 60000
fs_readonly_paths = ["/usr", "/lib"]
fs_writable_paths = ["$CONNECTOR_STATE"]
deny_exec = true
deny_ptrace = true

# Signatures and supply chain metadata are added during `fwc install`
# Do not add demo values here
